site: Example bench (glowing-torch Unitree Go2 MuJoCo simulator driver)
notes: Example only, not a statement about any Unitree Go2 deployment and not a device limit. The pinned simulator reads motor_cmd q, kp and kd and states no numeric bound for them, so the driver declares each operator_required and refuses every /mujoco/lowcmd publication with MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET until the operator supplies this reviewed envelope. Replace every value below with the deployment's reviewed joint envelope; the overlay may only narrow the driver's limit.

motor_cmd[*].q.reason: example: replace with the reviewed joint position envelope

motor_cmd[*].kp.reason: example: replace with the reviewed joint stiffness envelope

motor_cmd[*].kd.reason: example: replace with the reviewed joint damping envelope
